posts.text:
Too many Brussels sprouts? Don't bin them

If you are wondering what to do with too many Brussels sprouts, start with how you cook them. I like to roast them with olive oil and balsamic vinegar for a caramelised flavour. You can also boil or steam whole sprouts for six to eight minutes. That way, nothing from your harvest gets wasted.

Check your local frost dates.

Full guide on homegrownplate.co.uk/plants/brussels-sprouts/
